description: This file defines classes and functions related to tensor expression evaluation and interpretation within the Torch JIT Tensorexpr framework, including InterpValue class, SimpleIREvaluator, and expression substitution utilities.

classes.name: InterpValue
classes.description: Represents an interpreted value with various constructors for different data types and methods for type-safe access.

classes.name: SimpleIREvaluator
classes.description: Implements an evaluator for tensor expressions, capable of binding variables, executing code, and retrieving evaluated values.

classes.name: ExprEval
classes.description: Template class for evaluating tensor expressions with code generation, supporting variable binding and function calls.

methods.name: InterpValue()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to integer zero.

methods.name: InterpValue(Dtype dtype, T v)
methods.description: Template constructor for creating an InterpValue of a specific dtype.

methods.name: as<T>()
methods.description: Type-safe accessor for the stored value.

methods.name: as_vec<T>()
methods.description: Returns the stored vector of values.

methods.name: SimpleIREvaluator(...)
methods.description: Constructor for the evaluator, initializing with a statement, buffer args, device, and kernel name.

methods.name: call(const std::vector<CallArg>& args)
methods.description: Executes the code with provided arguments.

methods.name: call_raw(const std::vector<void*>& args)
methods.description: Executes the code with raw pointers.

methods.name: bindVar(const VarPtr& v, const ExprPtr& e)
methods.description: Binds a variable to an expression.
